liquidity_population: Items categorized by the recovered key code as key, fungible or wear-designated nonfungible, with at least one observed day before nominal event. Percentile of item-specific median daily quantities, before price, history-length or liquidity selection. pandas linear quantile.
liquidity_interval: All available history from 2013-04-26 through 2019-10-27 inclusive; item-specific coverage differs
interval_overlap_status: Unknown. No interval start/end or trade identifiers are supplied; summing all positive quantities reproduces the source implementation but cannot authenticate nonoverlap.
currency_status: No currency field; USD attribution is manuscript/dataset documentation, not independently authenticated row-wise. No conversion performed.
case_mapping_status: Explicit29-case whitelist and associated24key names agree exactly with frozen exclusion; not a post-result membership adjustment. Steam primary pages support key families; mapped page URLs retained for review.
data_transform_description: Daily sum of recorded quantities; quantity-weighted mean of window median price summaries, not authenticated transaction VWAP.
